Subject: Order form insurance — umbrella & additional insured

Priyom —

Thanks for sending the draft order form. A couple of insurance items popped up from our procurement team that we need to resolve before legal signs:

- General liability: we need Redwood to add Clearwater Financial as Additional Insured on the GL policy.
- Umbrella: Clearwater requires $5,000,000 umbrella; your order form shows $2,000,000. Can you confirm availability or propose a bridge?
- COI timing: we need a COI naming Clearwater on execution or at minimum an interim binder while endorsement is processed.

Attaching the latest MSA + order form marked with the insurance asks (Clearwater_MSADraft_v3.pdf). Can we get a response by EOD PT 10/19 — we want to hit our legal deadline on 10/22.

Best,
Sophie

Subject: Re: Order form insurance — umbrella & additional insured

Sophie —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front: we can provide Additional Insured for General Liability via a CG 2010 endorsement and deliver an interim COI. The umbrella limit gap is the sticking point — our carrier currently writes a $2M umbrella; increasing to $5M would require either a supplemental purchase (lead time / cost) or a short-term waiver.

Proposed path:
1) We will provide an interim COI (showing current GL + umbrella binder if available) by EOD 10/21.
2) Legal (Kimberly) is reviewing specific endorsement language; we can accept Additional Insured on the GL but need primary/non-contributory language to match the MSA redline.
3) For the $5M umbrella ask, can Clearwater accept either: (a) an umbrella purchase to $5M (we can provide pricing but need 2–3 weeks), or (b) a temporary exception for closing with a 30-day remediation plan to increase umbrella to $5M?

I attached our redline to show proposed carve (Redwood_MSA_blackline_20271018.docx). Can we schedule a 30-min call tomorrow 10/19 at 11am PT to align? Aditya — please coordinate calendar.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Team / Sophie —

I reviewed Clearwater's requested language and proposed the following edits to the order form (high level):

- Additional Insured: Redwood will add Clearwater Financial and its affiliates as Additional Insured on the Commercial General Liability policy with respect to Redwood's work under the Agreement, using the CG 2010 (or equivalent) endorsement.
- Primary/Non-Contributory: We can agree to primary and non-contributory wording but request mutual carve-outs for claims arising from Clearwater's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
- Umbrella: Redwood's current umbrella limit is $2,000,000. If Clearwater requires $5,000,000, Redwood proposes either (i) a commercially reasonable order-level surcharge for the additional premium and a 21-day lead time for carrier processing, or (ii) an interim acceptance of the $2M umbrella with a remediation plan to reach $5M within 30 days of execution. We should capture whichever option the customer prefers in Section 4.2 of the order form.
- COI Timing: Redwood will deliver an interim COI upon execution and a completed endorsement within 30 days; if the carrier requires more time, Redwood will provide a binder or insurer confirmation to meet procurement gate.

I attach a short sample clause and the CG2010 sample for discussion (CG2010_sample.pdf).

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

Attachment: CG2010_sample.pdf (PDF, sample endorsement)

Kimberly / Priyom —

Spoke with Redwood's broker this morning. Quick notes:
- Carrier can issue CG 2010 naming Clearwater Financial as Additional Insured for GL. They can also issue an interim certificate showing current limits.
- To issue the CG 2010 endorsement they need Clearwater's full legal entity name, mailing address, and EIN (or equivalent tax id).
- Regarding umbrella: carrier can quote a short-term endorsement from $2M to $5M but it will be a separate line item and requires signed authorization from Redwood. Pricing is modest but lead time is ~10 business days.

I've attached a sample CG 2010 and will forward a binder once underwriter confirms.

Ben Walsh
Senior Broker | LegalWorks Insurance

Sophie / Ben —

Thanks everyone — summary of what we agreed on the call and next steps so Clearwater can close on legal: 

1) Interim evidence: Redwood will deliver an interim COI (Interim_COI_Redwood_20271021.pdf) showing current General Liability limits and the umbrella binder status by 10/21 (delivered).
2) Additional Insured endorsement: Redwood will secure CG 2010 endorsement naming Clearwater Financial; broker (Ben) will coordinate carrier and provide endorsement within 10 business days.
3) Umbrella gap: Clearwater to confirm whether they will accept a 30-day remediation plan to increase to $5M (Redwood will procure and charge any incremental premium), or require the $5M at signing. Please confirm preference by EOD 10/23.
4) DocuSign: I will circulate the final order form via DocuSign once we have confirmation on the umbrella approach. DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/ABC123

If that aligns, we can close the order and Redwood will action the endorsement purchase immediately upon signature authorization.

Thanks —
